sloka: अथ शृङ्गं समाविध्य भीमं भीमपराक्रमः।चिक्षेप राममुद्दिश्य बलवानन्तकोपमः ।। ६.६७.११२ ।।
transliteration: atha śṛṅgaṁ samāvidhya bhīmaṁ bhīmaparākramaḥ।cikṣepa rāmamuddiśya balavānantakopamaḥ ।। 6.67.112 ।।

translations.english: "I am gratified by your valour, strength and enthusiasm which has been exhibited by you in the battle. However, I wish to kill Rama alone."
